1.sahih_international: Woe to those who give less [than due],
1.yusuf_ali: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
1.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to those who are fraudulent in (weighing and measuring),
1.mohsin_khan: Woe to Al-Mutaffifin [those who give less in measure and weight (decrease the rights of others)],

2.sahih_international: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
2.pickthall: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
2.yusuf_ali: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
2.shakir: Who, when they take the measure (of their dues) from men take it fully,
2.muhammad_sarwar: those who demand a full measure from others
2.mohsin_khan: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,
2.arberry: when they measure against the people, take full measure

3.sahih_international: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
3.pickthall: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
3.yusuf_ali: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
3.shakir: But when they measure out to others or weigh out for them, they are deficient.
3.muhammad_sarwar: but when they measure or weigh, give less.
3.mohsin_khan: And when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
3.arberry: but, when they measure for them or weigh for them, do skimp.

4.sahih_international: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
4.pickthall: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
4.yusuf_ali: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
4.shakir: Do not these think that they shall be raised again
4.muhammad_sarwar: Do they not realize that they will be resurrected
4.mohsin_khan: Think they not that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),
4.arberry: Do those not think that they shall be raised up

6.sahih_international: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
6.pickthall: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
6.yusuf_ali: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
6.shakir: The day on which men shall stand before the Lord of the worlds?
6.muhammad_sarwar: when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Universe?
6.mohsin_khan: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)?
6.arberry: a day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of all Being?

7.sahih_international: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
7.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
7.yusuf_ali: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
7.shakir: Nay! most surely the record of the wicked is in the Sijjin.
7.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to them! Let them know that the records of the sinner's deeds are in Sijin.
7.mohsin_khan: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjar (disbelievers, sinners, evil-doers and wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjin.
7.arberry: No indeed; the Book of the libertines is in Sijjin;

8.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
8.pickthall: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
8.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
8.shakir: And what will make you know what the Sijjin is?
8.muhammad_sarwar: Would that you knew what Sijin is!?
8.mohsin_khan: And what will make you know what Sijjin is?
8.arberry: and what shall teach thee what is Sijjin?

9.sahih_international: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
9.muhammad_sarwar: It is a comprehensively written Book (of records).

10.sahih_international: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
10.pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
10.yusuf_ali: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
10.shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters,
10.muhammad_sarwar: Woe, on that day, to those who have rejected God's revelations
10.mohsin_khan: Woe, that Day, to those who deny [(Allah, His Angels, His Books, His Messengers, the Day of Resurrection, and Al-Qadar (Divine Preordainments)].
10.arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies,

11.sahih_international: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
11.pickthall: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
11.yusuf_ali: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
11.shakir: Who give the lie to the day of judgment.
11.muhammad_sarwar: and those who have rejected the Day of Judgment.
11.mohsin_khan: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.
11.arberry: who cry lies to the Day of Doom;

12.sahih_international: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
12.pickthall: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
12.yusuf_ali: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
12.shakir: And none gives the lie to it but every exceeder of limits, sinful one
12.muhammad_sarwar: No one rejects it except the sinful transgressors
12.mohsin_khan: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience of Allah, the sinner!)
12.arberry: and none cries lies to it but every guilty aggressor.

13.sahih_international: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
13.pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
13.yusuf_ali: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
13.shakir: When Our communications are recited to him, he says: Stories of those of yore.
13.muhammad_sarwar: who, when listening to Our revelations, say, "These are only ancient legends".
13.mohsin_khan: When Our Verses (of the Quran) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"
13.arberry: When our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients!'

14.sahih_international: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
14.pickthall: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
14.yusuf_ali: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
14.shakir: Nay! rather, what they used to do has become like rust upon their hearts.
14.muhammad_sarwar: They will never have faith. In fact, their hearts are stained from their deeds.
14.mohsin_khan: Nay! But on their hearts is the Ran (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.
14.arberry: No indeed; but that they were earning has rusted upon their hearts.

15.sahih_international: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
15.pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
15.yusuf_ali: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
15.shakir: Nay! most surely they shall on that day be debarred from their Lord.
15.muhammad_sarwar: On the Day of Judgment, they will certainly be barred from the mercy of their Lord.
15.mohsin_khan: Nay! Surely, they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.
15.arberry: No indeed; but upon that day they shall be veiled from their Lord,

16.sahih_international: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
16.pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
16.yusuf_ali: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
16.shakir: Then most surely they shall enter the burning fire.
16.muhammad_sarwar: They will suffer the heat of fire
16.mohsin_khan: Then, verily they will indeed enter and taste the burning flame of Hell.
16.arberry: then they shall roast in Hell.

17.sahih_international: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
17.pickthall: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
17.yusuf_ali: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
17.shakir: Then shall it be said: This is what you gave the lie to.
17.muhammad_sarwar: and who will be told, "This is what you had called a lie".
17.mohsin_khan: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"
17.arberry: Then it shall be said to them, 'This is that you cried lies to.'

18.sahih_international: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
18.pickthall: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
18.yusuf_ali: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
18.shakir: Nay! Most surely the record of the righteous shall be in the Iliyin.
18.muhammad_sarwar: However, the records of the deeds of the virtuous ones will certainly be in Illiyin.
18.mohsin_khan: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrar (the pious who fear Allah and avoid evil), is (preserved) in 'Illiyyun.
18.arberry: No indeed; the book of the pious is in Illiyun;

19.sahih_international: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
19.pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
19.yusuf_ali: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
19.shakir: And what will make you know what the highest Iliyin is?
19.muhammad_sarwar: Would that you knew what Illiyin is!
19.mohsin_khan: And what will make you know what 'Illiyyun is?
19.arberry: and what shall teach thee what is Illiyun?

20.sahih_international: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
20.muhammad_sarwar: It is a comprehensively written Book (of records).

21.sahih_international: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
21.pickthall: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
21.yusuf_ali: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
21.shakir: Those who are drawn near (to Allah) shall witness it.
21.muhammad_sarwar: The ones nearest to God will bring it to public.
21.mohsin_khan: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allah, i.e. the angels).

22.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
22.pickthall: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
22.yusuf_ali: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
22.shakir: Most surely the righteous shall be in bliss,
22.muhammad_sarwar: The virtuous will live in bliss,
22.mohsin_khan: Verily, Al-Abrar (the pious who fear Allah and avoid evil) will be in delight (Paradise).
22.arberry: Surely the pious shall be in bliss,

23.yusuf_ali: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
23.muhammad_sarwar: reclining on couches, reviewing (the bounties given to them).

24.sahih_international: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
24.pickthall: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
24.yusuf_ali: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
24.shakir: You will recognize in their faces the brightness of bliss.
24.muhammad_sarwar: You can trace on their faces the joy of their bliss.
24.mohsin_khan: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.
24.arberry: thou knowest in their faces the radiancy of bliss

25.sahih_international: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
25.pickthall: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
25.yusuf_ali: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
25.shakir: They are made to quaff of a pure drink that is sealed (to others).
25.muhammad_sarwar: They will be given pure wine out of sealed containers
25.mohsin_khan: They will be given to drink pure sealed wine.
25.arberry: as they are given to drink of a wine sealed

26.sahih_international: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
26.pickthall: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
26.yusuf_ali: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
26.shakir: The sealing of it is (with) musk; and for that let the aspirers aspire.
26.muhammad_sarwar: which have the fragrance of musk. This is the kind of place for which one should really aspire.
26.mohsin_khan: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).
26.arberry: whose seal is musk -- so after that let the strivers strive --

27.sahih_international: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
27.pickthall: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
27.yusuf_ali: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
27.shakir: And the admixture of it is a water of Tasnim,
27.muhammad_sarwar: With the wine is a drink from Tasnim,
27.mohsin_khan: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnim.

28.sahih_international: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
28.pickthall: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
28.yusuf_ali: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
28.shakir: A fountain from which drink they who are drawn near (to Allah).
28.muhammad_sarwar: a spring, the nearest ones to God will drink from it.
28.mohsin_khan: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allah.
28.arberry: a fountain at which do drink those brought nigh.

29.sahih_international: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
29.pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
29.yusuf_ali: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
29.shakir: Surely they who are guilty used to laugh at those who believe.
29.muhammad_sarwar: The sinners had been laughing at the believers.
29.mohsin_khan: Verily! (During the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
29.arberry: Behold, the sinners were laughing at the believers,

30.sahih_international: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
30.pickthall: And wink one to another when they passed them;
30.yusuf_ali: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
30.shakir: And when they passed by them, they winked at one another.
30.muhammad_sarwar: When passing by them, they would wink at one another
30.mohsin_khan: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery);
30.arberry: when them passed them by winking at one another,

31.sahih_international: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
31.pickthall: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
31.yusuf_ali: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
31.shakir: And when they returned to their own followers they returned exulting.
31.muhammad_sarwar: and, on returning to their people, boast about what they had done.
31.mohsin_khan: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
31.arberry: and when they returned to their people they returned blithely,

32.sahih_international: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
32.pickthall: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
32.yusuf_ali: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
32.shakir: And when they saw them, they said: Most surely these are in error;
32.muhammad_sarwar: On seeing the believers, they would say, "These people have gone astray".
32.mohsin_khan: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily! These have indeed gone astray!"
32.arberry: and when they saw them they said, 'Lo, these men are astray!'

33.sahih_international: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
33.pickthall: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
33.yusuf_ali: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
33.shakir: And they were not sent to be keepers over them.
33.muhammad_sarwar: No one has appointed them to watch over the believers.
33.mohsin_khan: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).
33.arberry: Yet they were not sent as watchers over them.

34.sahih_international: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
34.pickthall: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
34.yusuf_ali: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
34.shakir: So today those who believe shall laugh at the unbelievers;
34.muhammad_sarwar: On the Day of Judgment, the believers will laugh at the disbelievers
34.mohsin_khan: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers
34.arberry: So today the believers are laughing at the unbelievers,

35.yusuf_ali: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
35.muhammad_sarwar: while reclining on couches and reviewing (the bounties given to them).

36.sahih_international: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
36.pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
36.yusuf_ali: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
36.shakir: Surely the disbelievers are rewarded as they did.
36.muhammad_sarwar: Will not the disbelievers then be duly recompensed for their laughing at the believers?
36.mohsin_khan: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?
36.arberry: Have the unbelievers been rewarded what they were doing?
